title: Siren of the Torii Portal
description: A mystical female figure with long flowing white hair stands in shallow water, wearing a bikini top and open robe with red white and blue patterns. She raises her hand as colorful koi fish and glowing jellyfish float around her. Behind her is a glowing Torii gate containing a swirling purple galaxy portal with an orca swimming inside, surrounded by ancient jungle ruins and a Dominican Republic flag on the beach.
prompt: A mystical long-haired woman with glowing white hair stands in shallow tropical water, wearing a revealing bikini and flowing robe with red white and blue patterns. She reaches upward as vibrant koi fish and luminous jellyfish swirl around her. A large wooden Torii gate stands behind her revealing a cosmic galaxy portal with an orca swimming inside. Ancient jungle ruins and palm trees frame the scene under a starry night sky with pink petals floating in the air, Dominican Republic flag lies on the sand, ethereal fantasy atmosphere.
